notes.title: Update Notes for 11/22 - Major Update To Controls, Achievements, More
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

As of 11/22, we've added a new update which overhauls a large segment of the game; particularly, it improves much of the visuals of the game, adds achievements, and overhauls controller usage.

Full changelog below:


 Visual update and improvements to all levels in the game. 
 New achievements, up to 17 achievements now.
 Controller fixes and improvements including locking twin stick aim when on controller.
 Various other bug fixes.
